description: All users are unable to log in. Authentication service is returning 503 errors. Error rate is 100%. Affects all regions. Started approximately 10 minutes ago.

Several enterprise customers in the EU region are reporting that PDF exports are failing silently. The export job appears to start but never completes. Estimated to affect roughly 15% of EU enterprise accounts.
Search latency has spiked from a baseline of 200ms to over 8 seconds on the US-East cluster. Database CPU is at 94%. No errors yet but user complaints are starting to come in.
One customer reports that their webhook endpoint stopped receiving events after they rotated their API key. Other customers on the same plan appear unaffected.

The nightly billing aggregation job failed to run last night. No charges were processed for the monthly billing cycle. Finance has been notified. Root cause appears to be a misconfigured cron job after last week's infrastructure migration.
